name: solana_webhook
summary: HTTP receiver on port 8524 (env MSPC_SOLANA_WEBHOOK_PORT) that accepts Helius / Triton / QuickNode webhook bodies AND raw custom JSON, verifies HMAC-SHA256, normalizes to a ChainEvent, and forwards to chain_event_render.render_one. The PUSH counterpart to program_monitor's PULL; both end at the same render call.
engine_pattern: Stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer. Routes: GET /webhook/solana (health), POST /webhook/solana (normalize then render), POST /webhook/solana/raw (skip normalize). HMAC verify against HELIUS_WEBHOOK_SECRET or MSPC_WEBHOOK_SECRET (header: X-Helius-Signature). Replay window 5 min (env MSPC_WEBHOOK_REPLAY_S; header X-Helius-Timestamp). Body cap 1 MB.
supported_payload_shapes: Helius enhanced — list of {type, signature, accountData[], nativeTransfers[], tokenTransfers[], slot, timestamp, source, events: {}}
Helius raw — list of {signature, logMessages[], slot, blockTime, err}
Custom — single dict already in ChainEvent shape (must have program_id + action)

smoke_test_2026_05_28.health_endpoint_returns: 200 OK with {ok, service, render_image, render_video, secret_set, replay_window_s}

security: HMAC-SHA256 verification — rejected with 401 if header missing or mismatched (when secret is set)
Replay-window check — rejects requests whose X-Helius-Timestamp is >300s away from now
Body cap 1 MB to prevent ingest-flood DoS
Unsigned requests accepted ONLY when no secret is set; server logs a warning each time
stdlib http.server runs single-process; no third-party WSGI; deploy behind Caddy + TLS for public exposure
cli: test [--url URL] [--secret X]                — self-call sanity test

operational_notes.where_to_register_the_endpoint_with_Heli: https://dashboard.helius.dev → Webhooks → 'Create Webhook' → Webhook URL: https://YOUR.DOMAIN/webhook/solana → Transaction Types: any of the enhanced types you care about → Account Addresses: paste from `cc programs-watchset` output (the watchset is the curated list this receiver knows how to interpret)
operational_notes.where_to_proxy_TLS_for_public_exposure: Caddy on droplet (159.89.181.146); add 'reverse_proxy /webhook/solana* studio-host:8524' to Caddyfile
operational_notes.local_only_alternative: Use program_monitor (PULL) + chain_event_render tail mode instead — zero external dep, zero cost

inbound_callers: Any custom signer that knows HELIUS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
outbound_calls: core/lib/program_registry.find() to enrich category from program_id

phase: Endpoint · push trigger for render bridge
